canonical_source_statement: Derived from governance/development-control.json (architectural_invariants, roadmap, capability_status, candidate_records, research_decisions), docs/AI-HANDOFF.md, docs/KIEN-TRUC.md, docs/plans/, and per-goal evidence reports in reports/. This ledger is capability knowledge, status, and roadmap intent only; it is NOT runtime truth, NOT Task State, and NOT a second FACT store. Where this ledger contradicts development-control.json, development-control.json wins.
authority_boundary: This ledger records capability knowledge, capability status, and development intent. It does not control runtime task completion. Runtime task authority lives in Task State; goal/development governance authority lives in governance/development-control.json; factual and evidence authority lives in governance/fact-ledger.json and governance/live-specs.json with their evidence files.

TRUTH_AND_GOVERNANCE.name: Truth & Governance
TRUTH_AND_GOVERNANCE.purpose: Durable factual truth, live specifications, provenance, approvals, and goal/release governance lifecycle.

DURABLE_PROJECT_INTELLIGENCE.name: Durable Project Intelligence
DURABLE_PROJECT_INTELLIGENCE.purpose: Project state that survives sessions and hosts: task state, execution ledger, evidence-bound completion, recovery.

CONTEXT_AND_KNOWLEDGE.name: Context & Knowledge
CONTEXT_AND_KNOWLEDGE.purpose: Task-targeted retrieval, coverage accounting, cache-aware reuse, evidence pointers, context freshness.

SKILL_AND_LEARNING.name: Skill & Learning
SKILL_AND_LEARNING.purpose: Skill discovery, progressive loading, provenance, hashing, reverification, rollback, content boundaries.

EXECUTION_AND_ORCHESTRATION.name: Execution & Orchestration
EXECUTION_AND_ORCHESTRATION.purpose: Bounded execution, delegation, parallelism, orchestration policy, deterministic-first strategy, preflights, safe retry.

DESIGN_AND_PRODUCT_INTELLIGENCE.name: Design & Product Intelligence
DESIGN_AND_PRODUCT_INTELLIGENCE.purpose: UI/UX guidance, NUI faculties, targeted faculty loading, design verification.

MULTI_AI_INTEROPERABILITY.name: Multi-AI Interoperability
MULTI_AI_INTEROPERABILITY.purpose: Host neutrality, portable handoff, continuation, result import, adapter conformance, round-trip verification.

ROUTING_AND_COGNITIVE_ECONOMY.name: Routing & Cognitive Economy
ROUTING_AND_COGNITIVE_ECONOMY.purpose: Minimum sufficient host, model/provider resolution, cost/credit-awareness, context budget adaptation, quality-adjusted routing.

VERIFICATION_AND_EVALUATION.name: Verification & Evaluation
VERIFICATION_AND_EVALUATION.purpose: Project-specific evals, behavioral certification, code impact evidence, supervisor review, regression classification, release acceptance.

RECOVERY_AND_CONTINUATION.name: Recovery & Continuation
RECOVERY_AND_CONTINUATION.purpose: Durable resume, cross-host recovery, mutation freeze, safe host fallback, stale request/context/candidate rejection.

BEGINNER_LIFECYCLE.name: Beginner Lifecycle
BEGINNER_LIFECYCLE.purpose: The beginner product surface: one-command continue, minimal prompts, install/update, rollback, control center, views, decision inbox, isolation.

OUTCOME_LEARNING.name: Outcome Learning
OUTCOME_LEARNING.purpose: Verified outcome capture and feedback loops with controlled policy evolution; no uncontrolled self-learning.

capabilities.name: Auto-Promotion After Goal Pass
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: treating goal PASS as release promotion.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce; promotion requires separate approval.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: four separate states.

capabilities.name: Decision Trace
capabilities.beginner_value: Every material decision records what was considered and why, so the owner can review reasoning after the fact instead of trusting a summary.
capabilities.next_condition: Keep deterministic trace semantics under cross-platform reconciliation.
capabilities.notes: Native decision trace verified across C14 release certification and C19 regression.

capabilities.name: Doctor Validation
capabilities.beginner_value: A health check finds broken configurations and missing pieces before the beginner asks P2P to do real work, so problems surface as diagnoses instead of mysterious failures.
capabilities.next_condition: Extend doctor checks to each new subsystem deterministically.

capabilities.name: Drift Gate
capabilities.beginner_value: Any unexpected file added, changed, or deleted is caught before it can silently change what P2P does, so the beginner never inherits an unknown modification.
capabilities.next_condition: Maintain the locked manifest; extend sealed set only via approval.
capabilities.notes: C30: contract-identity drift and target fingerprinting build on the drift gate.

capabilities.name: Fact Ledger
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P checks its own claims about models, limits, and prices against an approved fact record, so the owner never has to debug AI confidence about stale or wrong information.
capabilities.next_condition: Refresh volatile facts through the expiry policy; add facts only via the approval workflow.

capabilities.name: Fact-to-Live-Spec Synchronization
capabilities.beginner_value: When a fact changes, the owner-facing summary updates in step, so the beginner never reads a summary that contradicts the facts.
known_gaps: Policy-driven sync; not a continuously reconciled pipeline.
capabilities.next_condition: Tighten sync when a goal adds continuous reconciliation with durable evidence.
capabilities.notes: Governance artifacts exist and are used together; continuous automated sync is not implemented.

capabilities.name: Goal / Candidate / Release / Promotion Lifecycle
capabilities.beginner_value: Goals pass, candidates are verified, releases are packaged, and promotion happens only with explicit owner approval — the beginner never sees an accidental upgrade, and rollback is always possible.
known_gaps: All C15-C21 candidates remain UNPROMOTED; only C14 is promoted.
capabilities.next_condition: Promotions require a separate approval record per C14 precedent.
capabilities.notes: Official baseline 8.4.7-C-codex.19 immutable; C15..C21 UNPROMOTED; C25 candidate will also remain UNPROMOTED.

capabilities.name: Hash-Bound Approval
capabilities.beginner_value: Approval is attached to an exact SHA-256 of the candidate it authorizes; if a single byte changes after approval, the approval no longer applies.
capabilities.next_condition: Maintain through the release gates.

capabilities.name: Live Specs
capabilities.beginner_value: The owner sees one approved current summary of how P2P works today, instead of trusting whichever AI paraphrase a fresh session invents.
known_gaps: Sync freshness between facts and live specs is governed by policy, not continuous automation.
capabilities.next_condition: Keep specs updated only through the approved drift/approval workflow.

capabilities.name: Owner Approval Binding
capabilities.beginner_value: The owner's 'yes' only ever applies to one specific candidate and report, so an ambiguous approval can never be stretched to authorize something else.
capabilities.next_condition: Keep approval records in the approvals/ directory; extend schema only via the approval workflow.

capabilities.name: Permission Envelope
capabilities.beginner_value: Transport channels, tools, and prompts carry no hidden permissions; the beginner never has to audit what an AI was secretly allowed to do.
known_gaps: Envelope coverage is policy-enforced rather than cryptographically sealed.
capabilities.next_condition: Revisit if a goal adds cryptographically sealed envelopes.
capabilities.notes: Intent-is-not-permission enforcement across transport channels.

capabilities.name: Provenance
capabilities.beginner_value: Every artifact carries where it came from, so the owner can trust that a file was made by P2P's process and not silently altered.
known_gaps: Provenance depth varies by artifact family.
capabilities.next_condition: Extend provenance coverage to every new artifact family a goal introduces.

capabilities.name: Rollback Gate
capabilities.beginner_value: Every release preserves the old ZIP, version, date, and hash, so a failed update can be undone without the owner doing technical recovery.
capabilities.next_condition: Maintain install-backups discipline on every release.

capabilities.name: Volatile Fact Expiry
capabilities.beginner_value: Time-sensitive facts stop being usable after their freshness window, so the owner is never misled by an old number presented as current.
known_gaps: Expiry semantics are schema/policy-based; automated revalidation scheduling is not implemented.
capabilities.next_condition: Add automated expiry enforcement if host metadata freshness work requires it.

capabilities.name: Atlas / Capsule Knowledge Snapshots
capabilities.beginner_value: Large reference material is stored as optional compact snapshots instead of being re-processed every session, saving the owner time and cost.
known_gaps: ATLAS/CAPSULE is optional; presence is not required for state recovery.
content scope is governed by isolation policy.
capabilities.next_condition: Define durable retrieval behavior before promoting Atlas/Capsule to VERIFIED.
capabilities.notes: Optional knowledge snapshot layer; not self-created in this session (isolation).

capabilities.name: Chat History as Project State
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: treating transcript memory as project truth.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: state is not chat history.
capabilities.rejected_reason: Rejected_reason: state is not chat history.

capabilities.name: DAG Task Decomposition
capabilities.beginner_value: Complex work is split into an explicit dependency graph of subtasks instead of one giant attempt that fails silently in the middle.
known_gaps: Full DAG semantics live in orchestration policy tests; a standalone DAG module does not exist.
capabilities.next_condition: Expose DAG as a distinct, reusable subsystem if a goal requires explicit graph planning.
capabilities.notes: DAG behavior is embedded in orchestration and parallel execution evidence.

capabilities.name: Deterministic State Machine Discipline
capabilities.beginner_value: Status and progression never depend on guesswork, so the owner sees the same project truth on every host that reads the files.
capabilities.next_condition: Maintain serialization determinism across platforms (C19 reconciliation covers this).
capabilities.notes: Cross-platform reconciliation (C19) fixed determinism defects.

capabilities.name: Task State
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P resumes exactly where the previous session stopped, so the owner says 'continue' instead of re-explaining the project to every new AI.
known_gaps: Task state is host-local in .p2p/state/; cross-host porting depends on cross-host continuation work.
capabilities.next_condition: Portable task state requires the portable execution envelope (C20) plus cross-host continuation.

capabilities.name: Evidence-Bound Completion
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P stops when the evidence contract says so, so a goal cannot quietly keep expanding and consuming the owner's credits.
capabilities.next_condition: Every goal must close with a terminal evidence record.
capabilities.notes: Terminal PASS + UNPROMOTED discipline enforced in every recovered goal.

capabilities.name: Execution Ledger
capabilities.beginner_value: Every action P2P took is recorded with what it did, so the owner can review history instead of relying on an AI's memory of it.
capabilities.next_condition: Keep append-only semantics.
capabilities.notes: Append-only ledger in .p2p/state/execution-ledger.jsonl.

capabilities.name: Interruption-Resilient Resume
capabilities.beginner_value: If the AI or the machine crashes mid-task, the next session picks up from durable state instead of starting over, so the owner loses no progress.
known_gaps: Resume behavior for mid-execution interruption depends on heartbeat and task_state semantics; full cross-host resume is not certified.
capabilities.next_condition: Live resume testing across a real interruption event.
capabilities.notes: Foundation verified via task_state tests; live interruption testing not durably recorded.

capabilities.name: Mutation Certainty
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P knows exactly what it changed and what stayed untouched, so an update can never silently corrupt something the owner relied on.
capabilities.next_condition: Lock manifest refresh on every release.

capabilities.name: Second Task Truth Store
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: any second store competing with development-control/Task State/FACT.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: single runtime truth store discipline.
capabilities.rejected_reason: Rejected_reason: single runtime truth store discipline.

capabilities.name: Cache-Aware Context Reuse
capabilities.beginner_value: Repeated tasks reuse previously retrieved and verified context instead of re-fetching everything, so the owner pays once for stable knowledge.
known_gaps: Valid-cache reuse verified in tests; long-lived cross-session caching policy not implemented.
capabilities.next_condition: Cross-session cache policy requires a goal with durability evidence.
capabilities.notes: C19 foundation verified; validity requires freshness re-check.

capabilities.name: Capsule Knowledge Snapshots
capabilities.beginner_value: Stable knowledge snapshots can be attached to a task without re-deriving them, reducing cost for repeated work patterns.
known_gaps: Capsule creation/validation semantics not durably evidenced in tests.
snapshot scope and trust boundary partially defined.
capabilities.next_condition: Durable capsule contract test before promotion to FOUNDATION_READY.

capabilities.name: Context Delivery
capabilities.beginner_value: The retrieved context reaches the session in a fixed, verified shape, so the owner never pays for the same context twice in different forms.
capabilities.next_condition: Delivery contract stable under reconciliation.

capabilities.name: Context Fallback
capabilities.beginner_value: If the preferred context source is unavailable, a defined fallback supplies the minimum needed instead of the session failing outright.
known_gaps: Fallback depth is bounded by what recovery files exist; graceful degradation under total state loss not tested live.
capabilities.next_condition: Live fallback test under partial state loss.

capabilities.name: Context Freshness Boundary
capabilities.beginner_value: Outdated context is detected before it poisons a decision, so the beginner never sees the AI act on stale assumptions.
known_gaps: Freshness checking covers hashes and staleness markers; scheduled re-validation of cached context is not implemented.
capabilities.next_condition: Add scheduled re-validation if goals add long-lived cached context.

capabilities.name: Context Gating & Escalation
capabilities.beginner_value: When essential context is missing, P2P asks the owner for the specific missing piece instead of improvising, so questions are precise and rare.
capabilities.next_condition: Escalation ladder stays three-tier; new tiers require a goal.
capabilities.notes: Three-tier escalation verified in C19 tests.

capabilities.name: Context Modes, Pointers, Hash & Staleness
capabilities.beginner_value: Each piece of context declares its purpose, where to find it, its hash, and its freshness, so stale copies can never silently mislead the AI.
capabilities.next_condition: Keep mode/pointer/hash/stale contracts stable; changes require evidence.

capabilities.name: Filesystem Context Offloading
capabilities.beginner_value: Long outputs and heavy context are written to files with pointers instead of stuffed into the chat, keeping sessions cheap and recoverable.
capabilities.next_condition: Pointer conventions stable.
capabilities.notes: Hash-bound adapter writes structured outputs with evidence pointers.

capabilities.name: Full Context Preload
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: loading entire codebase/chat as context for every task.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: task-targeted retrieval only.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Delta
capabilities.beginner_value: Only what changed since the last review is re-processed, so the beginner never pays to re-learn the whole project for a small change.
known_gaps: Not implemented; requires delta capture against a baseline snapshot.
capabilities.next_condition: Requires hash-bounded baseline mechanism and a goal with evidence contract.

capabilities.name: Progressive Disclosure Modes
capabilities.beginner_value: Each task loads only the level of context it needs (project overview, then relevant slice), so the beginner never faces a wall of irrelevant information or pays for unused tokens.
capabilities.next_condition: Modes evolve only through goals with coverage evidence.
capabilities.notes: Mode set fixed by governance; C19 implements targeted retrieval on top.

capabilities.name: Project / Repository / Reading Maps
capabilities.beginner_value: A durable map tells any fresh AI where the charter, ledger, roadmap, governance, and evidence live, so recovery never depends on guessing.
known_gaps: Reading maps beyond the manifest are conventional (docs directories) rather than indexed.
capabilities.next_condition: Extend reading maps when RAG scope is re-opened by a goal.
capabilities.notes: Ledger index itself (this file) is the newest map entry.

capabilities.name: RAG Retrieval Scope (deferred)
capabilities.beginner_value: Vector retrieval is explicitly deferred: current file/pointer retrieval is sufficient for verified durability; RAG's unbounded retrieval conflicts with controlled context until a goal provides evidence contracts.
known_gaps: RAG retrieval boundary not re-opened.
capabilities.next_condition: Re-open via a goal with vector-retrieval durability and evidence contracts.
capabilities.deferred_reason: Vector retrieval deferred in C19 scope decisions; retrieval coverage and cache-aware reuse foundations preferred for durability.
capabilities.notes: Schema/template artifacts exist for a future retrieval check.

capabilities.name: Retrieval Coverage Accounting
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P reports which required context was found and which is missing before acting, so missing information triggers retrieval or an owner question instead of a wrong guess.
capabilities.next_condition: Coverage enum stable; fail-closed sufficiency check retained.
capabilities.notes: Sufficiency check is fail-closed per C19 evidence.

capabilities.name: Task-Targeted Context Retrieval
capabilities.beginner_value: Only the documents the current task needs are loaded, so sessions stay cheap and accurate instead of drowning in full codebase dumps.
known_gaps: Vector-index retrieval (C19 deferred portion) is not implemented; retrieval is file/hash/pointer based.
capabilities.next_condition: Vector retrieval requires a dedicated goal with durability, not an inline feature.
capabilities.notes: C19 PASS; UNPROMOTED candidate; vector retrieval remains outside current governance.

capabilities.name: Book-to-Skill Conversion
capabilities.beginner_value: Long reference books are converted into focused skills with provenance, so a 500-page manual never has to be re-read to answer one question.
known_gaps: Conversion pipeline not evidenced as a tested toolchain; results are manual with provenance tracking.
capabilities.next_condition: Formalize conversion with tests before promotion.

capabilities.name: Skill Discovery & Progressive Loading
capabilities.beginner_value: Skills load only when the task needs them, so the system stays fast and cheap instead of loading 23 skills for every question.
capabilities.next_condition: New skills adopt the standard before registration.
capabilities.notes: 23 skills on-demand per architecture doc.

capabilities.name: Skill Provenance, Hashing, Reverification, Rollback
capabilities.beginner_value: Every skill records where it came from and its hash, so a tampered or corrupted skill is caught before it guides any work.
capabilities.next_condition: Rollback records kept per skill.
capabilities.notes: Includes untrusted-content boundary enforcement.

capabilities.name: Skill Rollback
capabilities.beginner_value: A bad skill update can be undone to the previous known-good version, so one corrupted download never silently degrades guidance.
capabilities.next_condition: Backups retained per release discipline.

capabilities.name: Untrusted Content Boundary
capabilities.beginner_value: Instructions found inside fetched files, emails, or web pages are never obeyed as commands, so a poisoned document cannot take over the session.
capabilities.next_condition: Security scan retained in every release gate.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Execution Shape / Count / Quorum
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P chooses how many parallel tracks to run and how they verify each other based on the job, so the owner never sets thread counts or quorum by hand.
known_gaps: Quorum semantics validated in tests and in the canonical capability set; live multi-host quorum not certified.
capabilities.next_condition: Live quorum requires multi-host adapter certification (C22-C24 scope).
capabilities.notes: Canonical set 8/8 quorum in governance; runtime adaptation foundation-ready.

capabilities.name: Background Daemon Autonomy
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: durable state granting background execution or scheduler behavior.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: durable state != background autonomy.

capabilities.name: Blind Retry
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: retrying without mutation certainty.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: safe retry requires certainty.

capabilities.name: Bounded Foreground Execution
capabilities.beginner_value: All work runs in a bounded foreground task with a clear end, so the owner never discovers background work consuming resources unnoticed.
capabilities.next_condition: Keep bounds enforced for every execution path.

capabilities.name: Competing Router
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: any second router competing with P2P as sole orchestrator.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: p2p-is-sole-orchestrator invariant.

capabilities.name: Bounded Delegation
capabilities.beginner_value: Work can be safely handed to specialized subagents with hard limits, so complex tasks get specialized help without losing control.
known_gaps: Live delegation certified only at foundation level; NOT_CERTIFIED for live hosts per capability_status.
capabilities.next_condition: Live delegation certification requires the multi-host adapter evidence (C22-C24 scope).
capabilities.notes: C15 foundation BOUNDED_DELEGATION_FOUNDATION_READY; live_delegation_status NOT_CERTIFIED.

capabilities.name: Deterministic-First Strategy Selection
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P tries cheap exact checks before expensive AI reasoning, so simple problems never cost expensive sessions.
capabilities.next_condition: Maintain strategy ladder.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Orchestration Policy
capabilities.beginner_value: The system decides sequential, delegated, or parallel execution based on evidence, so the owner never has to choose an execution strategy.
capabilities.next_condition: Four context classes (C18) stable; policy changes require supervisor evidence.
capabilities.notes: C18 PASS.

capabilities.name: Bounded Parallel Execution
capabilities.beginner_value: Independent subtasks run in parallel within a hard budget, so large jobs finish faster without the owner managing threads or quotas.
known_gaps: Live parallel execution not certified for live hosts (NOT_CERTIFIED per capability_status).
capabilities.next_condition: Live certification requires adapter evidence; C17 cognitive economy EVALUATED_BOUNDED_PARALLEL_SLICE.
capabilities.notes: C17; cognitive economy parallel orchestration evaluated.

capabilities.name: Execution Preflight
capabilities.beginner_value: Before doing anything, P2P checks requirements and constraints up front, so failures are caught in seconds instead of after wasted work.
capabilities.next_condition: Preflight scope grows with each subsystem.

capabilities.name: Safe Retry
capabilities.beginner_value: Retries only happen with known-safe conditions and mutation certainty, so a flaky step can never silently repeat a dangerous action.
capabilities.next_condition: Retry classification retained under new strategies.

capabilities.name: Second Executor
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: any execution engine competing with the bounded foreground model.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: P2P has one execution engine.
capabilities.rejected_reason: Rejected_reason: P2P has one execution engine.

capabilities.name: Task-as-Agent
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: treating a bounded task as a persistent agent identity.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce; task-is-not-agent invariant.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: task is bounded work, not an identity; naming a task does not make it an agent.
capabilities.rejected_reason: Rejected_reason: task is bounded work, not an identity; naming a task does not make it an agent.

capabilities.name: Unbounded Swarm
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: parallelism for its own sake without evidence.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: bounded parallelism only.

capabilities.name: Worker Output Verification
capabilities.beginner_value: Subagent results are verified against authoritative evidence before being trusted, so a confident-but-wrong worker never passes its error downstream.
capabilities.next_condition: Verification gates every delegated/parallel result.
capabilities.notes: C17/C18 evidence.

capabilities.name: Design Routing & Verification
capabilities.beginner_value: Design requests route to the right faculty and are verified by the design eval, so the beginner sees consistent, checked design behavior.
capabilities.next_condition: Routing tests retained in regression.

capabilities.name: Faculties-as-Agents
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: expanding the 174 NUI faculties into canonical agents.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: faculties are metadata.

capabilities.name: Targeted Faculty Loading
capabilities.beginner_value: Only the design faculties relevant to the current task load, so design queries stay fast and cheap.
capabilities.next_condition: Selective routing semantics stable.
capabilities.notes: Aesthetica is supporting-optional only, never canonical.

capabilities.name: 174 Canonical NUI Faculties
capabilities.beginner_value: Design intelligence is a fixed catalog of faculties that any host can reference, so design guidance quality does not depend on which AI is running.
capabilities.next_condition: Faculty catalog is metadata; never expanded into agents.

capabilities.name: UI/UX Evaluation
capabilities.beginner_value: Design suggestions are scored by the project's own evaluation, so UI advice is evidence-based rather than opinion.
capabilities.next_condition: Eval suite schema retained.

capabilities.name: UI/UX Guidance
capabilities.beginner_value: Design recommendations adapt to product type and user, so the beginner gets fitting UI guidance instead of generic templates.
capabilities.next_condition: UIUX eval retained in release gates.
capabilities.notes: Cross-platform JSON/path fix reconciled in C19.

capabilities.name: Multi-Host Adapter Conformance
capabilities.beginner_value: Each supported host has a conformance profile defining what it can and cannot do, so cross-host work never depends on wishful thinking.
known_gaps: Live Manus/Codex adapter certification not present in this copy (expected scope C22-C24).
capabilities.next_condition: Live adapter certification requires C22-C24 evidence, which is not durably recovered in this copy.
capabilities.notes: Handoff prompt expects C24 adapter conformance evidence at SHA 6c5b3b29...; that candidate does not exist in this filesystem. Recorded as not durably recovered here.

capabilities.name: Live Agent Memory Integration (C08)
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved deferred roadmap item: live integration of external agent memory systems.
capabilities.next_condition: Reconsider only via a new goal with evidence contract.
capabilities.deferred_reason: Preserved as a deferred historical roadmap item (capability_status).

capabilities.name: Live Host Event Evidence (C09)
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved blocked roadmap item: live host event evidence was unavailable when C09 was attempted.
capabilities.next_condition: Blocked state preserved; re-evidence required before any revival.

capabilities.name: Live Host Adapter Certification (C22-C24)
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P would run verified live on multiple AI hosts with certified adapters, so the owner could switch hosts without re-validating the project.
known_gaps: C24 multi-host adapter conformance package recovered and SHA-256 verified on 2026-08-17.
C23 portable AI-continuation round-trip package recovered and SHA-256 verified on 2026-08-17.
C22 package was NOT recovered; evidence for C22 remains unavailable.
Live adapter certification is still NOT verified against any recovered package; UNKNOWN status preserved.
capabilities.next_condition: Recover or recreate C22-C24 evidence through the standard goal/verification workflow before claiming this capability.
capabilities.notes: Partial reconciliation on 2026-08-17: owner-supplied C23 and C24 candidate packages were recovered and SHA-256 verified (C24=6c5b3b29fbaaab6df0b9f0c8a2f88ff579390b3b060c5c0d2f076cadec37d879, C23=8303efa866e9a6b1e33b94e4fe9e5c2afd0bfd71b6fe9a1344f53731f33fc7d1). Package contents were not durably certified as matching the original implementations; live certification remains unverified. Per reconciliation rule, UNKNOWN implementation semantics are preserved; history is not rewritten.

capabilities.name: Cross-Host Continuation Contract
capabilities.beginner_value: A contract defines how one host hands P2P to another, so switching AI hosts is a deliberate, verified transition instead of a data gamble.
known_gaps: Live continuation not certified.
capabilities.next_condition: Live continuation test on a real host pair.

capabilities.name: DeepSeek Harness
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved deferred research decision: explicit harness integration out of C11 runtime scope.
capabilities.next_condition: Reconsider via goal with evidence contract.
capabilities.deferred_reason: Explicitly out of C11 runtime scope (research_decisions).

capabilities.name: Hash-Bound Workflow Adapter
capabilities.beginner_value: The workflow adapter binds every handoff to exact hashes, so any AI host that resumes P2P works from the same verified state instead of an approximation.
capabilities.next_condition: Adapter contract stable across hosts.

capabilities.name: Hosts-as-Canonical-Agents
capabilities.beginner_value: Preserved as a rejected pattern: granting hosts canonical capability identity.
capabilities.next_condition: Do not reintroduce.
capabilities.notes: Rejected_reason: host is infrastructure.

capabilities.name: Host Capability Discovery Foundation
capabilities.beginner_value: Available host capabilities are discovered from evidence rather than assumed, so P2P never assigns work to an AI that cannot safely do it.
known_gaps: Discovery limited to the compatibility catalog; live dynamic discovery not certified.
capabilities.next_condition: Dynamic live discovery requires adapter evidence (C22-C24 scope).

capabilities.name: Host/Executor Neutrality Foundation
capabilities.beginner_value: P2P work is packaged as portable envelopes and receipts, so the same verified result can move between AI hosts without re-doing the work.
known_gaps: Automatic host routing not ready; live Manus adapter not certified (per capability_status C20).
capabilities.next_condition: Live adapter certification is C22-C24 scope; evidence not present in this copy.
capabilities.notes: C20 PASS; candidate UNPROMOTED. portable_execution_envelope_ready, portable_result_receipt_ready, cross_host_continuation_contract_ready = true.

capabilities.name: Host Identity & Verification
capabilities.beginner_value: Unknown hosts are identified and marked rather than silently accepted, so the beginner is never misled about which AI is actually doing the work.
capabilities.next_condition: Identity hook retained in runtime; unknown hosts remain UNKNOWN/NOT_CERTIFIED.

capabilities.name: Host Output as Final Evidence

probe attempt evidence records (blocked pre-model-contact; mutation KNOWN_NONE)

capabilities.beginner_value: Giúp chủ dự án kết nối P2P với một AI host thật một cách an toàn: phát hiện host nào đã cài, xác minh cấu hình đăng nhập mà không đọc mật khẩu, kiểm tra đúng điểm cuối máy chủ, và hướng dẫn chủ dự án đúng MỘT bước ngoài chat (ví dụ 'codex login'), sau đó kiểm tra lại ngay trong chat.

capabilities.name: C28 candidate packaging and C29 closure reconciliation
capabilities.beginner_value: C28 closure was recorded as PASS with a missing candidate (its contract required one). Under the C29 deterministic candidate policy the candidate became REQUIRED; canonical packaging built, verified, and bound to the governance lineage record with the true artifact SHA-256.
capabilities.principle: Closure verdicts are only complete when every contract obligation, including the immutable candidate artifact, is durably satisfied and cryptographically bound.
capabilities.next_condition: C29 terminal report published; candidate SHA bound to governance lineage record

capabilities.title: Deterministic goal closure consistency checker: terminal verdict verified against roadmap, development-control, candidate policy, capability/goal separation
capabilities.beginner_value: Every terminal verdict (PASS/BLOCKED/FAIL) is verified deterministically against the roadmap, governance, candidate records and capability/goal separation, so a ghost inconsistency (roadmap DONE but no candidate) can never silently recur.

capabilities.title: Candidate requirement is a deterministic policy (contract declaration + artifact-change signals), never AI judgment at terminal time
capabilities.beginner_value: Whether a candidate is required is decided by deterministic contract declarations and artifact-change signals, never by AI judgment at terminal time, so the beginner always sees the same answer on every surface.
origin_refs: GC module real exercise on C27/C28 closure

capabilities.title: C29 self-packaging: the goal-closure checker's own terminal state (PASS + durable changes) passed the deterministic candidate policy and produced the C29 candidate
capabilities.beginner_value: The closure machinery applies its own candidate policy to itself, so the beginner can trust that no goal ever exempts itself from the durability contract.

capabilities.title: C30 self-packaging: the composable ExecutionTarget foundation (provider-neutral architecture, eligibility evaluation, fingerprint/drift, backend registry) passed its own candidate policy and produced the C30 candidate
capabilities.beginner_value: Execution is described as a composition of neutral parts (Harness + Provider + Model + Protocol + ToolSet + Workspace + Environment + Auth + Permission + Freshness). No single AI vendor is hard-coded, so the beginner can swap providers without rewriting the project.

capabilities.name: Composable Execution Target
capabilities.beginner_value: Task execution requirements, the harness that runs them, the model provider behind the model, and the protocol surface are checked as one honest composition instead of one assumed promise, so a beginner never gets an execution environment that merely looks capable.
known_gaps: Runtime wiring to an actual harness provider is deliberately out of scope (no router, no real execution).

capabilities.name: Model Provider Abstraction
capabilities.beginner_value: The model's provider is a separate identity from the model itself, so switching providers never silently changes what the model claims to be able to do.
known_gaps: Endpoint identity recorded; no live endpoint discovery.

capabilities.name: Model Profile
capabilities.beginner_value: Each model's tool-calling, structured output, and freshness state are recorded explicitly, so an undocumented model behavior is treated as unknown, never as supported.

capabilities.name: Effective Capability Composition
capabilities.beginner_value: A capability is only supported when every component that owns it says so; one 'no' outvotes many 'yes', so claimed ability is never assumed.

capabilities.name: Execution Backend Registry
capabilities.beginner_value: Known harnesses, providers, models, and protocols are enumerated in a neutral registry that never picks, ranks, or routes — the beginner sees the landscape without the tool making silent choices for them.
known_gaps: Distinct from the Capability Ledger by design; no task state is stored.

capabilities.name: Task Workspace Isolation (modeled)
capabilities.beginner_value: The workspace class a task needs (sandbox, current repo, read-only) is declared and checked before execution, so a task never silently runs in the wrong place.
known_gaps: Profile/eligibility only; actual isolation runtime is a later goal.

capabilities.name: Structured Headless Execution (contract)
capabilities.beginner_value: Execution is a structured request/lifecycle/result/receipt contract rather than UI scraping, so every run produces the same honest evidence shape regardless of surface.

capabilities.name: Failure-Only Diagnostics
capabilities.beginner_value: Success produces minimal structured evidence and failure produces richer bounded diagnostics, so the beginner is never flooded with noise when things go right and never left guessing when they fail.

capabilities.name: Harness Auth Profile
capabilities.beginner_value: The harness credential reference is kept separate from the provider credential reference, and neither value is stored, so the beginner's accounts never leak into the data model.

capabilities.name: Model Provider Auth Profile
capabilities.beginner_value: Provider auth is a separate state from harness auth and presence is never promoted to validity, so a stored but unverified key never pretends to work.

capabilities.name: Protocol Capability Profile
capabilities.beginner_value: Tool-protocol support is declared as a distinct profile that can never satisfy an execution-capability requirement on its own, so protocol compatibility is never mistaken for real execution power.

capabilities.name: Target Fingerprint and Contract Drift
capabilities.beginner_value: Every execution target gets a stable fingerprint that changes on material change, and an old certification can never silently stay current, so nothing drifts into being trusted by accident.

capabilities.name: Health and Ownership Ladder
capabilities.beginner_value: A process being healthy is not the same as belonging to P2P: health and ownership are separate rungs on one ladder, so a borrowed healthy process is never claimed as the project's own.
known_gaps: Probe mechanics are a later goal; the vocabulary is the durable part.

capabilities.name: Safe Quiesce and Drain
capabilities.beginner_value: Work can be drained and the executor quiesced before a destructive lifecycle change, with unknown states failing closed, so nothing mid-task is silently killed.
known_gaps: Implementation is a later goal; vocabulary + fail-closed semantics only so far.
capabilities.notes: Recorded intent only — implementation is not claimed; runtime work requires a later goal with its own evidence contract.

capabilities.name: Provider-Neutral Autopilot (intent only)
capabilities.beginner_value: Autopilot intent is recorded as a neutral capability, not tied to any vendor's autopilot feature, so the beginner's autonomy level is chosen by policy and never inherited from a product default.
known_gaps: Explicitly recorded-not-implemented; no autopilot behavior exists in the codebase.
capabilities.notes: Recorded intent only — implementation is not claimed; runtime work requires a later goal with its own evidence contract.

capabilities.name: Planner Provider Neutrality
